added.01: A tier chosen on the website now survives the sign-up letter.
added.02: The plan page now shows a booked downgrade and lets you keep your tier.

fixed.01: A declined card on an upgrade now says so.
fixed.02: A running fast no longer moves the header when its chip arrives.

added.01: The plan page now lists the tiers a plan service sells, and a subscriber can switch between them.
added.02: The order page now says what happens to your data above the payment boxes.
added.03: A plan can now leave out a feature, and the app shows it the same way everywhere.

changed.01: A spent day of AI scans now points at the plans where there are any.
changed.02: A refused feature now shows the same note instead of an error.

added.01: The sign-up page now says what happens to your data.

changed.01: The What's new card is hidden until you switch it on.
changed.02: The sign-out dialog now loads when it is needed, not with every page.
changed.03: The push gate now runs a scoped browser tier, and the full tier runs on a release tag and every night.
changed.04: The What's new card now sits at the end of the diary and the dashboard.
changed.05: The health consent text now says the operator can read your diary.

fixed.11: Cancel after a failed erase now takes you out of the diary.
fixed.12: The erase box no longer stays disabled when another tab hangs the check.
fixed.13: The sign-out dialog now announces a failed erase and gives focus back when it closes.
fixed.14: Another account can no longer open a diary left on a managed device.
fixed.15: A second press of Sign out while another tab holds the diary now reports the failure instead of hanging.
fixed.16: An erase now leaves no empty photo database behind.
fixed.17: The way-to-log cards on desktop onboarding hold their text.
fixed.18: The desktop sidebar no longer jumps when an administrator's role loads.
fixed.19: The What's new card no longer jumps when the pulse tile loads.
fixed.20: The delete-account dialog now says what stays.
fixed.21: The page description and the invite hint no longer say the instance is invitation only.
fixed.22: A photo that cannot be re-encoded is no longer sent as it is.

fixed.01: A browser-tier shard whose app server dies now stops and says so.
fixed.02: Signed-in people can now reach the legal pages from Settings.
fixed.03: A failed erase on sign-out now says so, and Escape no longer closes a running sign-out.
fixed.04: The sign-out dialog shows its erase warnings only after you tick the erase box.
fixed.05: The Settings sign-out button no longer claims it signs you out everywhere.
fixed.06: Signing out lands on the right page instead of flashing the front page.
fixed.07: Signing out now releases this device's push subscription.
fixed.08: A sign-out no longer hangs when the server never answers.
fixed.09: A suspended account is told it is suspended, not asked to sign in again.
